idea-plugin.name: Run Config Drift Detector
idea-plugin.description:
Run Config Drift Detector — Eliminate "Works on My Machine"

Run Config Drift Detector compares your IDE run configurations against a .run-requirements.yaml manifest, catching JDK mismatches, missing environment variables, and incorrect settings before they cause mysterious failures.

Environment Validation

  • JDK Validation — Verify JDK version and vendor match project requirements
  • Environment Variable Checks — Ensure required env vars are present with correct values
  • Working Directory Validation — Confirm paths resolve correctly
  • Port Conflict Detection — Detect ports already in use before running your application

Drift Reporting

  • Health Check Dashboard — Visual drift report with pass, fail, and warning indicators
  • Quick-Fix Suggestions — One-click corrections for every detected drift issue
  • Auto-Scan on Startup — Automatic validation when the project opens
  • Manual Re-Scan — Trigger a scan anytime from the Tools menu

Team Features (Pro/Team)

  • Auto-Generate Manifest — Create .run-requirements.yaml from existing run configurations
  • Team Config Sync — Share and synchronize run configurations across your team
  • Onboarding Mode — Guide new team members through environment setup
  • Common Issues Dashboard — See the most frequent drift issues across the team

Pricing

  • Free — Full drift detection (up to 10 requirements), health reports, quick fixes
  • Pro ($2.90/month or $29/year) — Unlimited requirements, auto-generate manifest, onboarding mode
  • Team ($5.90/user/month) — All Pro features + team sync, common issues dashboard, .env.example sync

Requirements

  • IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, WebStorm, or compatible JetBrains IDE (2024.1+)
  • A .run-requirements.yaml file in your project root

Support

  • Issues: GitHub
  • Email: support@jakubjirak.com
